description: This file is a C++ source file implementing classes, methods, and enumerations related to metadata management within the Thunder namespace. It includes definitions for service states, channels, subsystems, and server information, utilizing JSON serialization and external interface references.

classes.name: Metadata::Service::State
classes.description: Represents the state of a service, with JSON serialization capabilities and operators for assignment and data retrieval.

classes.name: Metadata::Service
classes.description: Encapsulates service configuration, versioning, and statistical data, with constructors, assignment operators, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Metadata::Channel
classes.description: Models a communication channel with remote, state, activity, id, and name attributes, supporting JSON serialization and copy/move semantics.

classes.name: Metadata::Server::Minion
classes.description: Represents a minion in the server's thread pool, with id, job, and run count, supporting JSON serialization and move semantics.

classes.name: Metadata::Server
classes.description: Contains thread pool and request queue information, supporting JSON serialization.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Main class aggregating subsystems, plugins, channels, bridges, process info, values, and version, with JSON serialization.

classes.name: Metadata::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystem states, allowing addition and JSON serialization.

methods.description: Assigns a service state from a shell interface or another state object.

methods.name: Metadata::Service::State::Data
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the current state.

methods.description: Constructors for minion objects with JSON attributes.

methods.name: Metadata::Server::Minion::operator=
methods.description: Assigns minion data from thread pool metadata.

methods.name: Metadata::Server::Server
methods.description: Constructor initializing thread pool and request data.
